name: Full Name
heroDesc: KrushiSevak bridges the gap between hardworking farmers, agricultural input stores (Krushi Seva Kendras), and fresh produce buyers with modern technology and regional insights.
benefitsSubtitle: Designed exclusively for Indian agrarian communities and rural empowerment
benefit1Desc: Direct farm-to-consumer and Kendra linkages ensuring maximum profit margins for farmers and fair rates for consumers.
benefit2Title: Free AI Crop Doctor & Treatment Plans
benefit2Desc: Early pest & disease diagnosis with instant, actionable organic and bio-chemical treatment guidance.
benefit3Desc: Hyper-local weather warnings, irrigation scheduling, and village-wise crop analytics.
featuresSubtitle: Comprehensive tools built for every participant in the agricultural value chain
feat1Desc: Analyze registered acreage, dominant crops, and yield forecasts across districts, talukas, and villages.
feat2Desc: Identify crop infections, fungal blights, and deficiencies with instant prescription remedies.
feat3Desc: Check live inventory, certified seed stocks, fertilizers, and govt subsidized inputs at nearby stores.
feat4Desc: Connect conscious consumers directly with passionate farmers for fresh harvest with complete traceability.
testimonialsSubtitle: Real experiences from farmers and consumers using KrushiSevak
farmerTestimonial1: "KrushiSevak made it effortless to manage my 6.5 acres of sugarcane and onions. The local weather advisories saved my crop from untimely rainfall!"
farmerTestimonial2: "Direct connection with buyers in Pune allowed me to sell my Thompson grapes at 30% higher realization without market agent cuts."
customerTestimonial1: "I receive fresh chemical-free vegetables and Sharbati wheat directly from farmers. Transparent pricing and unmatched farm freshness!"
